observations: In this historical BUILDIDX configuration, numeric continuation lines indented with spaces or tabs were rewritten without indentation; BUILDMSG generated only the first field for message 9900.
A trial of continuation lines beginning with unary plus was also removed by BUILDIDX.
Both BUILDMSG invocations completed successfully despite producing an incomplete 9900 payload, so exit status alone is insufficient.
next_action: Preserve the existing known-good single-line catalog record unless a supported continuation form is demonstrated; validate the full generated payload.
limitations: Failure describes these tested forms, not proof that all continuation formats are unsupported.
